posts.title: Screenplay: Seize The Initiative!
posts.description: ** Movie script and info ** EGG Fund grant proposal ** Short / Proof-of-Concept ** Soundtrack ** Script reviews ** Movie script and info The summary/logline: Saul puts the “action” into climate action, flirting with young women and roping them into volunteering for a carbon tax ballot measure campaign in Utah… but then he falls for Grace. Here’s the latest script (Nov 24, 2026). Here’s a draft scene list (filming schedule) / $500k budget . Here’s an old pitch deck in PDF (and in PPT , both from Feb 2026). Feedback, suggestions, and funding ideas are welcome! (Note that we have fiscal sponsorship through E2AC if you’re looking to make a tax-deductible donation!) FYI the script for the screenplay is adapted from the stage play, which has the same summary/logline and is described in more detail here . (This archived notes page covers both.)
